symptom: DESCRIBE PAGE kept emitting `pluggablewidget '<id>' name` for every widget after being changed to prefer the MDL name, with no error.
cause: LoadWidgetRegistry wants the .mpr PATH; LoadUserDefinitions takes filepath.Dir of it internally. Passing filepath.Dir(ctx.MprPath) looked one level above the project and found no definitions, so every lookup missed and the code fell back exactly as designed.
insight: A correct fallback hides a wiring bug perfectly: the output stays valid, so nothing fails and no test goes red. When adding a 'prefer X, else Y' path, assert the X branch is actually reached on a real project, not just that the output parses. Related: the registry is keyed BY MDL NAME, so two definitions claiming one name leave Get and GetByWidgetID disagreeing and All() cannot see the collision at all — guard by round-tripping the name through the same lookup the builder uses, never by counting definitions.
